notes.title: Updates! New languages & bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We wanted to let you know that you can play Sleep Attack in a lot of new languages now!
 
The following languages are now supported: Spanish, German, French, Polish, Czech, Portuguese and Dutch.


Also, all achievements should now work as intended, and a few bugs were fixed.

Hope you'll enjoy even more our tower defense! :)

notes.title: Patch June 3rd, 2015 - ChangeLog
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thanks for your feedback, your bug reports, your ideas ... well your support in general, helping us making Sleep Attack an even better game!

This is what the latest patch added:

- Leaderboards are now fully working. If you perform a better score replaying a level, only the difference between the old best score and your new one is added to your total score.

- Achievements. The progress of each achievement is now correctly shown. 

- The PigDog Whisperer achievement is now fixed. We decided to do not reset the achievement if you already gained it when bugged.

- Easter Eggs!

- Minor fixes
